project.title: Demo: carbonate transfer hypothesis
project.description: A deliberately small example showing how claims stay separated by evidence status.

entries.claim: A cited study reports carbonate adsorption on the catalyst surface.

source.citation: Example et al., Journal of Demonstrations (2026)

entries.notes: The source supports adsorption, not the complete transfer mechanism.

entries.claim: The reported adsorption makes surface activation a plausible intermediate step.
entries.notes: This is an inference from the cited fact, not a reported observation.

entries.claim: Carbonate oxygen may be retained in the product-forming bond.
test_plan: Repeat with 18O-labelled carbonate and compare product isotopologues.
entries.notes: A discriminating isotope experiment is required.

entries.claim: The current data do not establish whether formaldehyde is a co-product.
resolution_plan: Run an independent formaldehyde standard and a product-mass balance.
entries.notes: Keep this gap visible until the control experiment is complete.
